topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the manuscript tucked away in a hidden corner of the attic, the pages worn and folded as if they'd been revisited countless times. Each word, each sentence, crafted painstakingly, seemed to mirror the contours of our life together, a narrative I never knew was being penned. The air was thick with the scent of old paper and secrets. Here was a world I thought I knew, now layered with another dimension, one I had no part in creating. It sits there, heavy with silence, as I ponder the chapters I thought I understood, now ripe with new meanings.
